title: Keep one repetition until it changes you
summary: Let contentment, humility, and remembrance make the next repetition believable. Keep this close: Let this stay with you: when remembrance is real, it reaches the mouth and the walk.
takeaway: Choose the practice that leaves the heart steadier, not louder.
lifeApplication: Choose one repeatable cue today and keep it without negotiation, even if it is small enough to feel unremarkable.

source.shortMeaning: Naam deepens when one return is kept past mood and vanity.
source.lifeApplication: When novelty calls, keep today's repetition one round longer.
